solution.name: sp-new-library-uncheck-navigation-client-side-solution
solution.title: New List and Library Site Navigation Off by Default

shortDescription.default: Defaults "Show in site navigation" to unchecked when creating lists and libraries.

longDescription.default: Application Customizer that unticks the "Show in site navigation" checkbox in the modern Create list / Create document library panels, so new lists and libraries are not added to the site navigation by default.

features.title: Application Extension - Deployment of custom action
features.description: Deploys a custom action with ClientSideComponentId association
